verdict.rationale: Injecting per-call context is a fair axis for a voice-agent platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents it. No item mentions dynamic variables, prompt placeholders, or per-caller data passed when placing a call. The quickstart shows calls being placed via the API, and templates and multi-language prompts can be customized, but those are agent-level setup, not call-time personalization, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized
